source_to_Lean_obligations.source: Chapter5 Eqs5.3-5.15 pp75-76; identification-check.json latent covariance inversion
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithful_target: For real A,C,E define T=A+C+E, KMZ=A+C, KDZ=A/2+C. Prove 2(KMZ-KDZ)=A,2KDZ-KMZ=C,T-KMZ=E and injectivity of the explicit map(A,C,E)→(T,KMZ,KDZ).
source_to_Lean_obligations.proposed_representation: A triple of real scalars and explicit arithmetic functions; later connect this map to actual conditional Gaussian covariances.
source_to_Lean_obligations.assumptions: Real scalars suffice for the identities; strict positivity belongs to the statistical domain/bridge, not this ring calculation.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proof_route: Unfold definitions; ring for left-inverse identities; apply equality of observed triples and the left inverse to get injectivity.
source_to_Lean_obligations.likely_infrastructure: Real field arithmetic and Ring/NormNum tactics; nearby repo sources use these imports.
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithfulness_limit: This only formalizes the ACE covariance map. Do not name it identification of observed item data or assume the item-to-covariance bridge.
source_to_Lean_obligations.priority: First compilation target; no analytic infrastructure needed.

source_to_Lean_obligations.source: AppendixC pp138-139; identification-check.json binary path sign indeterminacy
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithful_target: For all real a,b, the paths a+b*m and a+(-2*a-b)*m have equal squares at m=0 andm=1. Prove a concrete positive-intercept witness with distinct slopes: a=1/2,b=1/5,bprime=-6/5; endpoint variances1/4,49/100 but midpoint variances9/25 and1/100.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proposed_representation: Squared affine real functions with explicitly named moderator values, exact rational constants cast toReal.
source_to_Lean_obligations.assumptions: Shared binary moderator; no condition requiring path positivity at both endpoints. Include distinct-slope proof in witness; degenerate a+b=0 does not produce two distinct slopes.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proof_route: Ring for universal endpoint equalities; norm_num for exact witness and distinctness.
source_to_Lean_obligations.likely_infrastructure: Real field arithmetic, Ring and NormNum only.
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithfulness_limit: Equality of endpoint variances supports the shared-moderator covariance symmetry; separate-twin moderators require cross-products, not just squares.

source_to_Lean_obligations.source: AppendixC p139 continuous extension; identification-check.json continuous moderator qualification
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithful_target: If two squared affine real paths agree at three distinct real moderator values, their coefficient pairs are equal or global negatives. With both intercepts strictly positive, only equality remains.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proposed_representation: PolynomialR of degree≤2, or exact Vandermonde interpolation of the squared difference followed by factorization into two affine polynomials.
source_to_Lean_obligations.assumptions: Three distinct actual support values; an integral domain of coefficients, hereReal. Strictlypositive intercepts only for removing the global negative solution.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proof_route: Derive the polynomial iszero from three roots and degree≤2; factor p²-q²=(p-q)(p+q), use no-zero-divisors, then coefficient equality. Alternatively derive all coefficients via explicit nonzero Vandermonde determinant.
source_to_Lean_obligations.likely_infrastructure: Polynomial degree/root bounds or finite interpolation; exact API unavailable locally and must be inspected after source availability.
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithfulness_limit: Do not replace three-support-point premise with equality for allm without proving that bridge. Does not prove finite-sample likelihood uniqueness.
source_to_Lean_obligations.priority: Small second-stage algebraic target after first successful compile.

source_to_Lean_obligations.faithful_target: Equality of exp(beta0+beta1*m) at two distinct real m values implies equality of both coefficients. For positive V0,V1 verify the explicit log-based inverse. Establish increasing/decreasing/constant variance curve according to slope sign.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proposed_representation: Real.exp of affine functions, a two-level observation map, and an explicit Real.log inverse on strictlypositive endpoints.
source_to_Lean_obligations.assumptions: Distinct moderator levels; positive finite endpoints for log formula. No item-data identifiability assumed or inferred by this lemma.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proof_route: Use injectivity/order of exp to reduce equalities/monotonicity to affine algebra; use exp/log inverse identities with positivity for reconstruction.
source_to_Lean_obligations.likely_infrastructure: Real exponential/logarithm algebra and order; FieldSimp/Ring; exact Mathlib lemma names and imports must be checked, not guessed.
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithfulness_limit: This is coefficient identification after variances are known; full observation-model bridge remains separate.
source_to_Lean_obligations.priority: Next tractable analytic-algebra target; modest compared with integration arguments.

source_to_Lean_obligations.faithful_target: For a nonempty finite set of observed all-zero Rasch responses, fixed finite difficulties and any probability law for finite latent residual vectorZ independent of mu, define Q(mu,Z)=product logistic(b-mu-Z). Show L(mu)=integral Q(mu,Z) strictly increases when mu decreases, so it has no finite maximizer. Optionally prove supremum1 as mu→−infinity.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proposed_representation: A finite nonempty index type of observations, a probability measure on a finite-dimensional real residual space, explicit logistic/product kernel and integral likelihood. Connect residual distribution shift to the actual Gaussian model separately.
source_to_Lean_obligations.assumptions: Measurable finite-valued residuals, probabilitymass1, finite known difficulties, nonempty observation set, conditional Bernoulli independence. No arbitrary strict-monotonicity assumption onL.
source_to_Lean_obligations.proof_route: Prove0<Q<1 and pointwise strict improvement for mu-d with d>0; boundedness gives integrability; strict integral inequality gives no maximizer. Supremum1 additionally needs dominated convergence along mu=-n.
source_to_Lean_obligations.likely_infrastructure: Finite products, measurable logistic functions, probability integrals, strict-integral inequality and bounded domination. A Gaussian integration library is not needed for the general fixed-Z lemma, but the Gaussian-model likelihood bridge must be supplied.
source_to_Lean_obligations.faithfulness_limit: Do not assume a conclusion-bearing likelihood monotonicity hypothesis. Proper priors change the posterior objective; no posterior impropriety or empirical contradiction follows.
source_to_Lean_obligations.priority: Bounded medium-size analytic target after basic integrals are available; not part of first compile.
